captions.detailed: A premium-scale vacuum kitchen blender featuring a large, tapered gray base with an angled dark front control panel. The control panel houses a single circular dial knob and three separate rectangular push buttons arranged horizontally below it. Atop the base sits a transparent, slightly frosted plastic jug with a thick black handle and a black lid, which has a small rotatable vacuum valve flap on top. Inside the bottom of the jug, a small metal blending blade is mounted.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a premium vacuum blender. The model should include a tapered base with an angled front panel, a rotating control knob, three independent prismatic push buttons, a transparent jug with a handle, a lid with a revolute vacuum flap, and a spinning blade assembly inside the bottom of the jug.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blender by first building a tapered base using a loft or extruded face with draft, and cutting out an angled front recess for the control panel. The control knob is created as a cylinder with continuous rotation on its Z-axis, while the three buttons are modeled as small boxes with prismatic limits. The jug is extruded as a hollow tapered shell with an attached rectangular handle. A lid is formed with a small revolute hinge flap modeled on top. Finally, a small multi-blade propeller is created as a continuous rotating joint situated at the bottom floor of the jug.
